{"id":1814963072,"question_id":3676,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1761737794,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1814963072/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Smallest Number With All Set Bits","memory":"8.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string toBinary(int n)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(n>0)\n        {\n            int digit = n % 2;\n            ans.push_back(digit + '0');\n            n /= 2;\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n    int smallestNumber(int n) {\n       string num = toBinary(n);\n       int size = num.size();\n       \n       int zeros = 0;\n       for(auto ch : num)\n       {\n            if(ch == '0') zeros++;\n       }\n\n       return (zeros == 0) ? n : pow(2,size)-1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"smallest-number-with-all-set-bits","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1006}
